image_description: A high-angle, wide shot of an ornate church interior featuring a central altar. The altar is a raised structure with a white frontal cloth, positioned beneath a large, elaborate gilded altarpiece (reredos) that extends vertically towards the vaulted ceiling. The space includes side walls with arched windows letting in bright light, and religious paintings on either side of the main altar. The architecture suggests a Baroque or Rococo style.
